scientific_integrity: The known geometric 221-chamber number is explicitly credited. Both exact standalone verifiers exhaust all eleven-curve subsets; geometric exhaustiveness is separately proved using Bezout and adjunction. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary five-point blowups with exactly two specified triple lines, characteristic at least five; counts concern the smooth minimal resolution and rational chamber supports, not the alternate eight-line quartic type or the singular Weil-divisor cone. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Frobenius-fixed Zariski chambers of the nine-line two-nodal quartic del Pezzo resolution
